section_01_hero.prompt:
Create a hero section image.
=== CRITICAL REQUIREMENTS ===
1. EXACT DIMENSIONS: 1200x1200 pixels - MUST be exactly 1200px wide and 1200px tall
2. FULL BLEED: content fills the ENTIRE 1200x1200 with NO margins or borders
=== PHOTOGRAPHY STYLE (MANDATORY) ===
Use REALISTIC PHOTOGRAPHY, NOT illustration. Real Korean female model, mid-20s, clear healthy dewy skin, natural bare-face makeup, gentle smile, holding a small light-green glass jar of green tea moisture cream near her cheek. Soft natural morning light, fresh green tea leaves and water droplets, clean mint-green studio background. High-end Korean beauty ad quality (Sulwhasoo/Innisfree/Laneige). Natural skin texture. Leave clean upper-left space for Korean headline overlay. no text in image.
=== FINAL CHECKLIST ===
Exactly 1200x1200, full bleed, realistic photo of a real person's face, no text.
